claims.assertion: Swaruu X says the Federation is a multi-species alliance for security, trade and cooperation, founded by Andromedans, Arcturians and Lyrians.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X

claims.assertion: The Federation uses tiered holographic councils, escalating unresolved matters from local to larger regional, planetary and stellar councils.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X

claims.assertion: Swaruu X says the Federation isolates Earth technologically and mentally to preserve a lower-consciousness experience.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X
claims.qualifiers: She identifies the Van Allen belts as one part.

claims.assertion: Since 2021, Taygeta recognizes Federation ties only through the Alcyone Council after disputes over Earth policy.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X
claims.qualifiers: She says Taygetans approved the arrangement.
